name: Frontier
comment: Frontier is a HPE Cray EX exascale supercomputer at OLCF. 77 Olympus rack cabinets × 128 compute nodes = 9,856 nodes. Source: https://docs.olcf.ornl.gov/systems/frontier_user_guide.html

parts.name: Frontier Compute Partition
parts.comment: 77 Olympus rack cabinets × 128 nodes each = 9,856 compute nodes. Source: https://docs.olcf.ornl.gov/systems/frontier_user_guide.html

cpus.name: EPYC 7A53

tdp.comment: TBD: estimated; AMD EPYC 7A53 TDP not officially published

cpus.comment: AMD 'Optimized 3rd Gen EPYC' (Milan/Trento). Each node has 1× 64-core CPU. Source: https://docs.olcf.ornl.gov/systems/frontier_user_guide.html

memory.comment: 512 GB DDR4 per node with 4 NUMA domains. Source: https://docs.olcf.ornl.gov/systems/frontier_user_guide.html

accelerators.name: Instinct MI250X

amount.comment: HBM2E per accelerator card: one MI250X card comprises 2 GCDs with 64 GB each

tdp.comment: TBD: estimated 4× MI250X at ~140W per card; exact per-card TDP not documented in user guide

accelerators.comment: Compute units of the full card. Each MI250X has 2 Graphics Compute Dies (GCDs); the 8 GCDs per node appear as 8 separate GPUs to Slurm and ROCm. Source: https://docs.olcf.ornl.gov/systems/frontier_user_guide.html

numa_topology.comment: NUMA 0: hardware threads 000-007, 064-071 | GPU 4; threads 008-015, 072-079 | GPU 5
NUMA 1: hardware threads 016-023, 080-087 | GPU 2; threads 024-031, 088-095 | GPU 3
NUMA 2: hardware threads 032-039, 096-103 | GPU 6; threads 040-047, 104-111 | GPU 7
NUMA 3: hardware threads 048-055, 112-119 | GPU 0; threads 056-063, 120-127 | GPU 1

node_types.comment: 9,856 identical compute nodes. 56 allocatable cores per node (8 reserved: 1 core per L3 region for system processes and SLURM core specialization). Source: https://docs.olcf.ornl.gov/systems/frontier_user_guide.html
